lines.say: Proxima Centauri is the nearest star to the Sun, about four point two light-years away.
lines.en: Proxima Centauri is the nearest star to the Sun, about 4.2 light-years away.
lines.ja: プロキシマ・ケンタウリは、太陽にいちばん近い恒星です。距離は約 4.2 光年です。

lines.say: A planet, Proxima b, goes around it once in about eleven days.
lines.en: A planet, Proxima b, goes around it once in about 11 days.
lines.ja: その周りを、惑星プロキシマ b が約 11 日で一周しています。

lines.say: Some scientists study small probes that could fly past this planet.
lines.en: Some scientists study small probes that could fly past this planet.
lines.ja: この惑星のそばを通り過ぎる小さな探査機を、研究している人たちがいます。

lines.say: At one fifth of the speed of light, the trip takes more than twenty years.
lines.en: At one fifth of the speed of light, the trip takes more than 20 years.
lines.ja: 光の速さの 5 分の 1 で飛んでも、旅には 20 年以上かかります。

lines.say: Aiming such a probe needs a prediction, made before launch, of where the planet will be when the probe arrives.
lines.en: Aiming such a probe needs a prediction, made before launch, of where the planet will be when the probe arrives.
lines.ja: そうした探査機の狙いには、着いたときに惑星がどこにいるかの予測が、打ち上げの前に要ります。

lines.say: This paper asks a simple question: how well can we know that position before launch?
lines.en: This paper asks a simple question: how well can we know that position before launch?
lines.ja: この論文の問いは一つです。その位置を、打ち上げの前にどれだけよく知ることができるか。

lines.say: Picture a flat sheet at the planet, at right angles to the probe's path.
lines.en: Picture a flat sheet at the planet, at right angles to the probe's path.
lines.ja: 惑星のところに、探査機の進む向きと直角に、平らな板を思い浮かべてください。

lines.say: We call it the target plane.
lines.en: We call it the target plane.
lines.ja: これを「的の面」と呼びます。

lines.say: The data have errors, so the paper cannot predict one exact point.
lines.en: The data have errors, so the paper cannot predict one exact point.
lines.ja: データには誤差があるので、論文は一つのぴったりの点を予測することはできません。

lines.say: Instead, it gets a cloud of possible positions on the sheet.
lines.en: Instead, it gets a cloud of possible positions on the sheet.
lines.ja: 代わりに、板の上に、ありうる位置の雲が得られます。

lines.say: Now draw the smallest circle that holds ninety percent of the cloud.
lines.en: Now draw the smallest circle that holds 90% of the cloud.
lines.ja: では、雲の 90% を含む、いちばん小さい円を描きます。

lines.say: Its radius is called r ninety.
lines.en: Its radius is called r₉₀ ("r ninety").
lines.ja: その半径を r₉₀(アール・ナインティ)と呼びます。

lines.say: A small r ninety means a sharp prediction. A large r ninety means a vague one.
lines.en: A small r₉₀ means a sharp prediction. A large r₉₀ means a vague one.
lines.ja: r₉₀ が小さければ予測は鋭く、大きければ予測はぼんやりしています。

lines.say: How small is small enough?
lines.en: How small is small enough?
lines.ja: どこまで小さければ十分でしょうか。

lines.say: One published study says the total error must be about one hundred thousand kilometers or less.
lines.en: One published study says the total error must be about 100,000 km or less.
lines.ja: 発表された研究の一つは、誤差の合計を約 10 万 km 以下にする必要がある、としています。

lines.say: That is about one quarter of the distance from the Earth to the Moon.
lines.en: That is about one quarter of the distance from the Earth to the Moon.
lines.ja: これは、地球から月までの距離の約 4 分の 1 です。

lines.say: The paper uses this value as one mark, not as the only possible requirement.
lines.en: The paper uses this value as one mark, not as the only possible requirement.
lines.ja: 論文はこの値を一つの目安として使い、ただ一つの要求とはしていません。

lines.say: So it tests thirteen radii, from ten thousand kilometers to ten million kilometers.
lines.en: So it tests 13 radii, from 10,000 km to 10 million km.
lines.ja: そのため、1 万 km から 1000 万 km までの、13 の半径を試します。

lines.say: To make the prediction, the paper combines two kinds of data.
lines.en: To make the prediction, the paper combines two kinds of data.
lines.ja: 予測を作るために、論文は二種類のデータを組み合わせます。

lines.say: The Gaia space telescope measured the star's position, distance, and motion across the sky.
lines.en: The Gaia space telescope measured the star's position, distance, and motion across the sky.
lines.ja: 宇宙望遠鏡ガイアは、星の位置と距離と、空を横切る動きを測りました。

lines.say: Radial velocities measure how fast the star moves toward us and away from us, as the planet pulls on it.
lines.en: Radial velocities measure how fast the star moves toward us and away from us, as the planet pulls on it.
lines.ja: 視線速度は、惑星に引かれて星がこちらへ近づく速さと、遠ざかる速さを測ります。

lines.say: The model moves the star along its path, with a small pull from the bright pair Alpha Centauri A and B.
lines.en: The model moves the star along its path, with a small pull from the bright pair Alpha Centauri A and B.
lines.ja: モデルは、明るい二つの星アルファ・ケンタウリ A と B のわずかな引力を加えて、星をその道筋に沿って動かします。

lines.say: It moves the planet along its orbit around the star.
lines.en: It moves the planet along its orbit around the star.
lines.ja: そして、惑星を、星の周りの軌道に沿って動かします。

lines.say: Another planet, Proxima d, and Einstein's gravity slowly turn the orbit of b.
lines.en: Another planet, Proxima d, and Einstein's gravity slowly turn the orbit of b.
lines.ja: もう一つの惑星プロキシマ d と、アインシュタインの重力は、b の軌道をゆっくり回します。

lines.say: If the model leaves out planet d, the predicted position moves by thirty-six thousand to two hundred twelve thousand kilometers.
lines.en: If the model leaves out planet d, the predicted position moves by 36,000 to 212,000 km.
lines.ja: モデルから惑星 d を外すと、予測の位置は 3 万 6 千 km から 21 万 2 千 km ずれます。

lines.say: That is about the same size as the mark. The model for future observations includes this effect.
lines.en: That is about the same size as the mark. The model for future observations includes this effect.
lines.ja: これは目安とほぼ同じ大きさです。将来の観測のためのモデルは、この効果を含めています。

lines.say: Next, a fair test.
lines.en: Next, a fair test.
lines.ja: 次は、公正な試し方です。

lines.say: The paper fixed its rules in writing before it ran each computation.
lines.en: The paper fixed its rules in writing before it ran each computation.
lines.ja: 論文は、それぞれの計算を走らせる前に、決まりを書いて固定しました。

lines.say: It also uses eight versions of the model.
lines.en: It also uses eight versions of the model.
lines.ja: また、モデルを 8 通り使います。

lines.say: They make different choices about the planet, the star, and the orientation of the orbit.
lines.en: They make different choices about the planet, the star, and the orientation of the orbit.
lines.ja: 8 通りは、惑星・星・軌道の向きについて、違う選び方をしています。

lines.say: A test radius counts as reached only if r ninety is inside it in all eight versions.
lines.en: A test radius counts as reached only if r₉₀ is inside it in all eight versions.
lines.ja: 試す半径に「届いた」と数えるのは、8 通りの全てで r₉₀ がその内側にあるときだけです。

lines.say: If r ninety is outside it in all eight, it is not reached.
lines.en: If r₉₀ is outside it in all eight, it is not reached.
lines.ja: 8 通りの全てで外側なら、「届かない」です。

lines.say: If the versions disagree, the answer is undecided.
lines.en: If the versions disagree, the answer is undecided.
lines.ja: 8 通りの答えが分かれたら、「判定不能」です。

lines.say: And undecided never means no.
lines.en: And undecided never means no.
lines.ja: そして、判定不能は「届かない」という意味ではありません。

lines.say: So what do today's data give?
lines.en: So what do today's data give?
lines.ja: では、今のデータでは、どうなるでしょうか。

lines.say: At the launch years on the list, r ninety is seven point two to nine point four five million kilometers.
lines.en: At the launch years on the list, r₉₀ is 7.2 to 9.45 million km.
lines.ja: リストにある打ち上げの年では、r₉₀ は 720 万 km から 945 万 km です。

lines.say: That is about the size of the planet's orbit, and about seventy to ninety-five times the mark.
lines.en: That is about the size of the planet's orbit, and about 70 to 95 times the mark.
lines.ja: これは惑星の軌道くらいの大きさで、目安の約 70 倍から 95 倍です。

lines.say: Better data for any single input, alone, does not reach the mark.
lines.en: Better data for any single input, alone, does not reach the mark.
lines.ja: どれか一つの入力だけを良くしても、目安には届きません。

lines.say: Among the largest parts of the error is the orientation of the orbit: how the orbit is turned in space.
lines.en: Among the largest parts of the error is the orientation of the orbit: how the orbit is turned in space.
lines.ja: 誤差のいちばん大きい部分の一つは、軌道の向き、つまり軌道が空間でどちらを向いているかです。

lines.say: Radial velocities do not measure it.
lines.en: Radial velocities do not measure it.
lines.ja: 視線速度は、これを測りません。

lines.say: Next, the paper adds possible future observations.
lines.en: Next, the paper adds possible future observations.
lines.ja: 次に、論文は、将来ありうる観測を加えます。

lines.say: Their quality is an assumption, not a forecast.
lines.en: Their quality is an assumption, not a forecast.
lines.ja: その性能は仮定で、予報ではありません。

lines.say: The list includes pictures that show the planet apart from its star, more precise Gaia data, more radial velocities, and a more precise speed of the star toward us.
lines.en: The list includes pictures that show the planet apart from its star, more precise Gaia data, more radial velocities, and a more precise speed of the star toward us.
lines.ja: リストには、惑星を星から離して写す撮像、より精しいガイアのデータ、より多くの視線速度、そして星がこちらへ向かう速さのより精しい値が入っています。

lines.say: There is one more problem. The planet goes around its star in about eleven days, so a change of a few days in the arrival time puts the planet at a very different place on its orbit.
lines.en: There is one more problem. The planet goes around its star in about 11 days, so a change of a few days in the arrival time puts the planet at a very different place on its orbit.
lines.ja: もう一つ問題があります。惑星は約 11 日で星を一周するので、着く時刻が数日ずれると、惑星は軌道のまったく違う所にいます。

lines.say: So the paper checks twenty-four launch times spread over one orbit, and the rule must hold at all of them.
lines.en: So the paper checks 24 launch times spread over one orbit, and the rule must hold at all of them.
lines.ja: そこで論文は、一周の間に広げた 24 の打ち上げの時刻を調べ、その全てで決まりが成り立つことを求めます。

lines.say: With this check, the smallest test radius with a definite earliest launch year is three hundred sixteen thousand kilometers at one fifth of the speed of light, and five hundred sixty-two thousand kilometers at one tenth.
lines.en: With this check, the smallest test radius with a definite earliest launch year is 316,000 km at one fifth of the speed of light, and 562,000 km at one tenth.
lines.ja: こう調べると、届く最も早い打ち上げの年がはっきり決まる、最も小さい試しの半径は、光速の 5 分の 1 で 31 万 6 千 km、10 分の 1 で 56 万 2 千 km です。

lines.say: At one hundred thousand kilometers, no setting gives a definite earliest launch year over the orbit.
lines.en: At 100,000 km, no setting gives a definite earliest launch year over the orbit.
lines.ja: 10 万 km では、一周を通して、届く最も早い年がはっきり決まる設定はありません。

lines.say: In one example, the largest r ninety of the eight versions moves between about eighty-three thousand and one hundred forty-four thousand kilometers as the launch time changes.
lines.en: In one example, the largest r₉₀ of the eight versions moves between about 83,000 and 144,000 km as the launch time changes.
lines.ja: ある例では、打ち上げの時刻を変えると、8 通りの中でいちばん大きい r₉₀ が、約 8 万 3 千 km から 14 万 4 千 km の間を動きます。

lines.say: The six settings that the paper checked over the orbit combine those pictures with much more precise Gaia data and star speeds.
lines.en: The six settings that the paper checked over the orbit combine those pictures with much more precise Gaia data and star speeds.
lines.ja: 論文が一周を通して調べた 6 つの設定は、その撮像に、はるかに精しいガイアのデータと星の速さを組み合わせたものです。

lines.say: If you check only one launch time in each year, these six settings do reach one hundred thousand kilometers at one fifth of the speed of light.
lines.en: If you check only one launch time in each year, these six settings do reach 100,000 km at one fifth of the speed of light.
lines.ja: 各年の打ち上げの時刻を一つだけ調べるなら、この 6 つの設定は、光速の 5 分の 1 で 10 万 km に届きます。

lines.say: Without pictures of the planet, no combination on the list gets below ten million kilometers.
lines.en: Without pictures of the planet, no combination on the list gets below 10 million km.
lines.ja: 惑星の撮像が無いと、リストのどの組み合わせも 1000 万 km を下回りません。

scenes.title: What the paper does not claim
scenes.title_ja: 論文が主張しないこと

lines.say: The paper is careful about its limits.
lines.en: The paper is careful about its limits.
lines.ja: 論文は、自らの限界をはっきり書いています。

lines.say: The r ninety values come from the model, and their calibration has not been verified: no one has yet confirmed that a ninety percent circle holds the true position ninety percent of the time.
lines.en: The r₉₀ values come from the model, and their calibration has not been verified: no one has yet confirmed that a 90% circle holds the true position 90% of the time.
lines.ja: r₉₀ の値はモデルから出たもので、その較正は確かめられていません。90% の円が本当に 90% の割合で真の位置を含むかは、まだ誰も確かめていないのです。

lines.say: The future instrument performances are assumptions, and the paper does not claim that the observations will be made.
lines.en: The future instrument performances are assumptions, and the paper does not claim that the observations will be made.
lines.ja: 将来の装置の性能は仮定で、論文は、その観測が行われるとは主張しません。

lines.say: It also says nothing about whether or when a mission is possible, or about life on the planet.
lines.en: It also says nothing about whether or when a mission is possible, or about life on the planet.
lines.ja: また、任務ができるかどうかやその時期、惑星の生命については、何も言いません。

lines.say: In short, the paper measures how far today's knowledge is from the mark, and which observations on its list come closest.
lines.en: In short, the paper measures how far today's knowledge is from the mark, and which observations on its list come closest.
lines.ja: まとめると、論文は、今の知識が目安からどれだけ遠いかと、リストのどの観測がいちばん近づくかを測っています。

lines.say: The paper and its files are open on Zenodo.
lines.en: The paper and its files are open on Zenodo.
lines.ja: 論文とそのファイルは、Zenodo で公開されています。

lines.say: This video was made with the help of AI, and the voice is synthetic.
lines.en: This video was made with the help of AI, and the voice is synthetic.
lines.ja: この動画は AI の助けを借りて作り、声は合成音声です。
